correctness.rationale: Exact diagonalization in the 3-vertex zero-sum subspace gives two spectral eigenvalues and projectors. The signed quadratic identity sorts off-diagonal projectors by conductance; the weakest-edge kernel has a scalar ratio strictly monotone by convexity of y^r. This yields an exhaustive one-crossing time law and all positive-edge entries, with exact row-sum amplification. Explicit eigenvalues prove both singular order asymptotics. Independently computed matrix powers and exponentials matched the formulas in 20,272 deterministic numerical comparisons; tests are supplementary, not infinite proofs.
